body:
In specific case, creating block pointer is very slow.

![pointer](https://github.com/openai/triton/assets/7459074/cf5fb269-411c-4735-a674-66b6eedc9385)

```
pointer:
   y_size  x_size  block pointer  pointer block
0    32.0    32.0       0.024209       0.025256
1    64.0    64.0       0.025827       0.024142
2   128.0   128.0       0.024124       0.025241
3   256.0   256.0       0.147073       0.028446
```

When the size of block is 256, it takes 6x more time than pointer block.
You can check this code at [here](https://github.com/daemyung/gpups/blob/main/pointer.py) to reproduce it.
title: 'block_pointer' is slower than 'pointer block'
